benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status.
benefits.terms: Automatic with cardmembership by linking a Marriott Bonvoy account.

benefits.name: Annual Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: 15 Elite Night Credits toward Marriott Bonvoy elite status tiers each calendar year.
benefits.terms: Credits count toward Marriott Bonvoy elite status thresholds; stackable with nights credited from stays.

benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.description: One Free Night Award, redeemable for a night at a Marriott Bonvoy property with a redemption level at or under 50,000 points, after spending $15,000 on the card in a calendar year.
benefits.terms: Requires $15,000 in eligible purchases within the calendar year. Can be topped up with up to 25,000 of the cardholder's own points for a higher-category redemption.

benefits.name: Bonus Points per Paid Stay
benefits.description: 1,000 bonus Marriott Bonvoy points per paid eligible stay booked directly with Marriott at participating properties.
benefits.terms: Flat per-stay bonus, not a percentage multiplier. Requires direct booking with Marriott at a Marriott Bonvoy participating property.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers new purchases against accidental damage or theft for 90 days.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 5 years or less by an additional year.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement for reasonable expenses when a covered trip is delayed 12+ hours.

benefits.name: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.description: Coverage for lost, damaged, or stolen checked or carry-on luggage.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss & Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage or theft of most rental vehicles.

earningRates.terms: Restaurants worldwide and U.S. supermarkets, on up to $15,000 in combined purchases per calendar year, then 2x.
